title: nan
authors: Quach C.H.; Vo C.T.; Tran D.L.T.; Nguyen T.S.; Phung M.D.; Tran T.H.
key_contribution: Presents cross-fusion, a cross-session 3D LiDAR and monocular camera fusion method for real-time UAV localization in GPS-denied environments, with performance comparable to GPS-based methods.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
